requirements_summary: Workload: chat-first support agent + on-demand document search; reranking for ticket triage.
Latency/throughput: target P95 < 120ms for chat, sustained 200-300 req/s; embeddings throughput 800-1200 reqs/min with batching acceptable.
Cost sensitivity: mid-high — must demonstrate unit-econ improvement vs existing $0.15/query baseline; target <$0.08/query at scale.
Model preferences: open to Llama2-class & third-party quantized models; prefers verified perf profiles; fallback to smaller model during peak.
Routing/fallback: require policy to route to Hosted when Dedicated capacity is saturated; graceful degradation plan required.
Security/compliance: SSO (SAML), audit logs retention, KMS integration for VPC Private deployment later stage, data residency for EU customers.
Optimization asks: recommended batching config per route, prefix/KV cache strategy for repetitive queries, quantization settings (int8/4) for cost-vs-quality tradeoffs.
Eval constraints: 2-week POC, measurable baseline & delta; cost-workshop to include NPV style unit economics worksheet.
poc_plan: Scope: Hosted API baseline -> Dedicated reserved slice simulation -> Quantized model profile testing (int8), prefix KV cache, continuous batching across 3 primary routes.
Metrics: tokens/sec, p95 latency, cost/token estimate, hit-rate on KV cache, quality regression on reranking (top-5 accuracy).
Deliverable: POC report with microbenchmarks, recommended Dedicated sizing + price slice, cost-model spreadsheet (unit economics at 10k & 100k MAU).
Risks: SOC2 retention questions could delay Dedicated onboarding; quality/regression risk with aggressive quantization — include eval set.
